asr.full_text: This is Shah and Doge is currently sitting at a very critical point where the market is attempting to break out. But this is exactly where confirmation matters the most because this is also where fake breakouts happen. Right now, the Price is around 0.096. In our last update, after a clean bounce from the strong support at 0.090 we marked a bearish order block around 0.095 that level was acting as a key resistance and we clearly said that for any further bullish continuation doge needs to break above it now the market respected that level perfectly after the bounce price moved up and tested the bearish order block multiple times In fact it faced rejection twice from that same zone which confirmed that sellers were actively defending it and that the level was strong But here is where it gets interesting even after those rejections price kept coming back to the same resistance level This behavior is important because repeated tests of a resistance often weaken it over time. Each test removes some of the selling pressure, increasing the probability of a breakout. And now that is exactly what we are seeing. Doge is attempting to break above the $0.095 level. However, just moving slightly above Resistance is not enough to confirm a breakout this is where many traders make mistakes by entering too early for a proper bullish confirmation we need to see at least two strong four-hour candles closing above zero point zero nine five this would confirm that buyers have taken control and that the resistance has successfully flipped into support, if that confirmation happens then the structure shifts from a range into a bullish trend. Once that transition is confirmed, the next target becomes very clear, which is around 0.10 That levels acts as both a technical resistance and a psychological level where price often reacts A move towards 0.10 becomes highly probable if momentum continues and the breakout holds However you also need to stay aware of the downside scenario If Doge fails to hold above 0.095 and drops back below it then this breakout attempt can turn into a fake out in that case price can fall back into the previous range and potentially revisit the support at 0.090 this is why patience is critical here the market is at a decision point and instead of guessing the move you should wait for confirmation so the plan is very simple a confirmed hold about 0.095 shifts the direction to the upside towards 0.10 a failure to hold keeps the market ranging and brings downside risk back follow the the candles, not emotions!
